name: Pungallium
look: a green onion body on thin legs under a great purple allium flower-head, streaming eyes, hands to its face, a long orange tongue and leaf tendrils, a purple puff of stink beside it
entry: Its great flower-head smells so strongly that its own eyes stream with tears and its tongue hangs out in disgust. Bug Pokémon that come to feed on its nectar fall from the air in a faint.
how: Evolve Shallorn at level 34. It learns Petal Dance when it evolves.
Wild: rare in swamps and forests.
